topic.title: Adversarial Generative Modeling and Distribution Matching
topic.overview: Adversarial generators learn by competing with a model that distinguishes generated data from observations. This topic studies the distance or discrepancy that competition minimizes, how to stabilize training, and how to work with limited data. Related approaches connect adversarial objectives with moment matching, ensembles, and flow-based generation.
topic.whyItMatters: The discriminator supplies a learned training signal, but the choice of objective determines which distributional differences matter. A generator useful for downstream learning may need task-sensitive fidelity rather than only visually convincing examples, and fast sampling must be considered alongside diversity and training stability.
topic.evolution: Generative adversarial nets in 2014 formulate a two-player minimax game. Subsequent work modifies divergences, augmentation, and latent optimization. A 2019 approach uses task-dependent discrepancy for generators and ensembles; adversarial flow models in 2026 encourage deterministic noise-to-data transport while supporting one-step and multi-step generation through adversarial training.
openQuestions: Which discrepancies predict whether synthetic data will help a particular downstream task?
How can efficient adversarial generators preserve rare modes as well as common patterns?

papers.title: ContraGAN: Contrastive Learning for Conditional Image Generation

papers.title: COT-GAN: Generating Sequential Data via Causal Optimal Transport
papers.tldr: COT-GAN combines causal optimal transport with an improved Sinkhorn divergence to train effective, stable generators of time-series data.

papers.title: Differentiable Augmentation for Data-Efficient GAN Training
papers.tldr: Applying differentiable augmentations to both real and generated images improves GAN training when data are limited.

papers.title: Efficient Generation of Structured Objects with Constrained Adversarial Networks
papers.tldr: Constrained Adversarial Networks train generators with explicit logical requirements to efficiently produce valid structures with high probability.

papers.title: Estimating the Effects of Continuous-valued Interventions using Generative Adversarial Networks
papers.tldr: SCIGAN uses a modified GAN and hierarchical discriminator to estimate counterfactual outcomes for multiple continuously varying interventions.

papers.title: GANSpace: Discovering Interpretable GAN Controls
papers.tldr: GANSpace uses principal components and layer-wise perturbations to discover understandable controls for generated images.

papers.title: GS-WGAN: A Gradient-Sanitized Approach for Learning Differentially Private Generators
papers.tldr: GS-WGAN sanitizes training gradients to generate more informative synthetic data with rigorous privacy guarantees in centralized or federated settings.

papers.title: Improving GAN Training with Probability Ratio Clipping and Sample Reweighting
papers.tldr: A variational GAN framework stabilizes learning through generator-update clipping and discriminator sample reweighting, improving several text and image tasks.

papers.title: Instance Selection for GANs
papers.tldr: Selecting training instances before GAN training concentrates capacity on dense data regions and improves reported fidelity and efficiency.

papers.title: Reciprocal Adversarial Learning via Characteristic Functions
papers.tldr: RCF-GAN compares characteristic functions in an embedded space and reports improved generation and reconstruction using a two-module autoencoder structure.

papers.title: Robust Optimal Transport with Applications in Generative Modeling and Domain Adaptation
papers.tldr: An efficient dual formulation makes robust optimal transport practical for GAN training with outliers and improves evaluated domain-adaptation accuracy.

papers.title: Sampling-Decomposable Generative Adversarial Recommender
papers.tldr: SD-GAR combines importance sampling with a decomposable generator to improve recommendation performance and accelerate adversarial training.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Generative Adversarial Compression
papers.tldr: A trained discriminator supervises GAN generator compression, with reported strong performance at high sparsity and applicability across tasks and models.

papers.title: Teaching a GAN What Not to Learn
papers.tldr: The Rumi framework trains GANs with desired and unwanted examples, improving learning and reported generation quality.

papers.title: Top-k Training of GANs: Improving GAN Performance by Throwing Away Bad Samples
papers.tldr: Updating GAN generators using only better-scoring batch samples improves results without increasing computational cost.

papers.title: Towards a Better Global Loss Landscape of GANs
papers.tldr: The paper proves a bad-basin advantage for relativistic pairing GAN loss over a class of separable objectives and supports it experimentally.

papers.title: Training Generative Adversarial Networks by Solving Ordinary Differential Equations
papers.tldr: ODE solvers combined with integration-error regularization stabilize GAN training, supporting the hypothesis that discretization contributes to instability.

papers.title: Training Generative Adversarial Networks with Limited Data
papers.tldr: Adaptive discriminator augmentation stabilizes GAN training with limited data, often matching StyleGAN2 results with roughly ten times fewer images.

papers.title: Your GAN is Secretly an Energy-based Model and You Should Use Discriminator Driven Latent Sampling
papers.tldr: Discriminator-guided sampling in latent space improves pretrained GAN outputs without adding parameters or retraining.

papers.title: A Unified Generative Adversarial Network Training via Self-Labeling and Self-Attention
papers.tldr: A unified GAN scheme uses artificial labels, self-labeling, and confidence-aware self-attention to improve generation across labeling regimes.

papers.title: Discretization Drift in Two-Player Games
papers.tldr: Analyzing how discrete updates alter two-player dynamics reveals drift components that can be controlled to improve GAN training.

papers.title: Functional Space Analysis of Local GAN Convergence
papers.tldr: A function-space analysis of local GAN dynamics connects convergence to dataset-estimable quantities and guides augmentation selection before training.

papers.title: Generative Adversarial Networks for Markovian Temporal Dynamics: Stochastic Continuous Data Generation
papers.tldr: A GAN combines stochastic differential equation generation, constrained discrimination, and a Markov Wasserstein distance to model random temporal dynamics.

papers.title: On Characterizing GAN Convergence Through Proximal Duality Gap
papers.tldr: Proximal duality gap broadens GAN convergence monitoring beyond Nash equilibria and connects it theoretically to distributional mismatch.

papers.title: Pareto GAN: Extending the Representational Power of GANs to Heavy-Tailed Distributions
papers.tldr: Pareto GAN combines tail-aware representation and alternative metric spaces to learn heavy-tailed data more stably.

papers.title: Provable Lipschitz Certification for Generative Models
papers.tldr: Layerwise zonotope approximations provide provable Lipschitz upper bounds that extend to generative networks with large outputs.

papers.title: Train simultaneously, generalize better: Stability of gradient-based minimax learners
papers.tldr: Stability analysis links minimax optimization choices to generalization and suggests benefits from simultaneous gradient updates with similar learning rates.

papers.title: Uncertainty Principles of Encoding GANs
papers.tldr: Three theoretical incompatibilities in encoding GANs help explain why ideal reconstruction, continuity, accurate approximation, and stability cannot all be expected together.

papers.title: Understanding Noise Injection in GANs
papers.tldr: A Riemannian-geometric framework explains noise injection in GANs and treats StyleGAN’s mechanism as a Euclidean special case.

papers.title: WGAN with an Infinitely Wide Generator Has No Spurious Stationary Points
papers.tldr: The studied two-layer WGAN has no spurious stationary points at infinite generator width, with expanding regional guarantees for finite wide generators.

papers.title: A Unified View of cGANs with and without Classifiers
papers.tldr: A unified probabilistic framework explains several conditional GAN designs and guides a classifier-based approach that improves reported benchmark performance.

papers.title: Bounds all around: training energy-based models with bidirectional bounds
papers.tldr: Training energy-based models with upper and lower likelihood bounds provides a principled route to more stable learning and high-quality generation.

papers.title: CAM-GAN: Continual Adaptation Modules for Generative Adversarial Networks
papers.tldr: CAM-GAN combines compact task adapters and task-similarity information to improve continual generation with fewer parameters.

papers.title: Data-Efficient GAN Training Beyond (Just) Augmentations: A Lottery Ticket Perspective
papers.tldr: Selecting and training a sparse GAN subnetwork improves learning from limited images and provides gains complementary to data augmentation.

papers.title: Data-Efficient Instance Generation from Instance Discrimination
papers.tldr: InsGen improves GAN training with limited data by teaching the discriminator to distinguish individual real and generated images.

papers.title: Deceive D: Adaptive Pseudo Augmentation for GAN Training with Limited Data
papers.tldr: Adaptive Pseudo Augmentation uses generated images to reduce discriminator overfitting and improve GAN training with limited data.

papers.title: Diffusion Models Beat GANs on Image Synthesis
papers.tldr: Improved architectures and classifier guidance let diffusion models surpass comparison generators in image quality while offering a diversity–fidelity tradeoff.

papers.title: Instance-Conditioned GAN
papers.tldr: IC-GAN models overlapping neighborhoods around individual examples to improve complex image generation and enable transfer through new conditioning instances.

papers.title: Invertible Tabular GANs: Killing Two Birds with One Stone for Tabular Data Synthesis
papers.tldr: A tabular GAN uses invertible-network density regularization to favor either synthesis quality or greater separation from real records and stronger empirical privacy resistance.

papers.title: Low-Rank Subspaces in GANs
papers.tldr: LowRankGAN factors region-specific Jacobians to discover latent directions for more precise, transferable control of generated images.

papers.title: Non-asymptotic Error Bounds for Bidirectional GANs
papers.tldr: The paper derives nearly sharp finite-sample BiGAN error bounds without requiring equal distribution dimensions or bounded support for the main result.

papers.title: On the Frequency Bias of Generative Models
papers.tldr: GAN spectral artifacts reflect both generator and discriminator behavior, with weak-frequency detection and discriminator downsampling emerging as promising targets for improvement.

papers.title: Particle Cloud Generation with Message Passing Generative Adversarial Networks
papers.tldr: MPGAN improves particle-cloud generation over tested point-cloud GANs, alongside a new JetNet dataset and evaluation toolkit.

papers.title: Projected GANs Converge Faster
papers.tldr: Projected GAN mixes fixed pretrained features across channels and resolutions to improve image generation and reach prior best FID results up to forty times faster.

papers.title: Rebooting ACGAN: Auxiliary Classifier GANs with Stable Training
papers.tldr: ReACGAN improves conditional image generation by controlling classifier input scale and learning from relationships among labeled examples.

papers.title: Rethinking conditional GAN training: An approach using geometrically structured latent manifolds
papers.tldr: Encouraging a bi-Lipschitz latent-to-output mapping during Pix2Pix training yields more diverse and realistic image translations in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Revisiting Discriminator in GAN Compression: A Generator-discriminator Cooperative Compression Scheme
papers.tldr: GCC coordinates generator compression, discriminator capacity, and teacher distillation, reporting 80% lower computation with comparable image-translation performance.

papers.title: Self-Diagnosing GAN: Diagnosing Underrepresented Samples in Generative Adversarial Networks
papers.tldr: A GAN training method identifies underrepresented examples through discrepancy statistics and improves reported sample quality and diversity, especially for minor groups.

papers.title: Self-Supervised GANs with Label Augmentation
papers.tldr: Augmenting real/fake labels with transformation information aligns GAN self-supervision with generation and improves reported modeling and representation results.

papers.title: Statistical Regeneration Guarantees of the Wasserstein Autoencoder with Latent Space Consistency
papers.tldr: The paper provides statistical guarantees linking Wasserstein autoencoders’ latent distribution consistency to regeneration of the input distribution.

papers.title: Time-series Generation by Contrastive Imitation
papers.tldr: A cooperatively trained transition policy and contrastive energy model generate time series while accounting for whole-trajectory behavior.

papers.title: To Beam Or Not To Beam: That is a Question of Cooperation for Language GANs
papers.tldr: SelfGAN makes generators and discriminators cooperate on training sequences, improving learning guidance and reported language-generation results.

papers.title: Why Spectral Normalization Stabilizes GANs: Analysis and Improvements
papers.tldr: The paper explains spectral normalization through gradient control and introduces BSSN, with stronger theoretical control and improved reported GAN training.

papers.title: A Neural Tangent Kernel Perspective of GANs
papers.tldr: An architecture-aware neural tangent kernel framework resolves ill-defined discriminator gradients in previous GAN analyses and yields insights into training dynamics.

papers.title: Conditional GANs with Auxiliary Discriminative Classifier
papers.tldr: ADC-GAN uses a generator-aware auxiliary classifier to address reduced within-class diversity in conditional GANs.

papers.title: Exploring and Exploiting Hubness Priors for High-Quality GAN Latent Sampling
papers.tldr: Hubness-based sampling identifies promising GAN latent inputs before image generation and explains the truncation trick through hub clustering.

papers.title: Generative Cooperative Networks for Natural Language Generation
papers.tldr: Generative Cooperative Networks combine discriminator information with a generation policy, with convergence guarantees and strong reported text-generation results.

papers.title: Generative Trees: Adversarial and Copycat
papers.tldr: Generative trees adapt decision-tree losses, structures, and boosting to tabular generation through adversarial and copycat training.

papers.title: ME-GAN: Learning Panoptic Electrocardio Representations for Multi-view ECG Synthesis Conditioned on Heart Diseases
papers.tldr: ME-GAN generates multiple ECG views conditioned on heart disease, with mechanisms for localized disease features and correct view characteristics.

papers.title: Principled Knowledge Extrapolation with GANs
papers.tldr: An adversarial formulation changes a chosen knowledge dimension while preserving the rest of a distribution, with principal knowledge descent estimating the extrapolated result.

papers.title: Region-Based Semantic Factorization in GANs
papers.tldr: A regional optimization method discovers local semantic controls in pretrained GANs without annotations or additional training.

papers.title: Score-Guided Intermediate Level Optimization: Fast Langevin Mixing for Inverse Problems
papers.tldr: SGILO guides posterior sampling with a learned intermediate-layer prior and improves inverse-problem results, especially with few measurements.

papers.title: Structure-preserving GANs
papers.tldr: Structure-preserving GANs coordinate invariant discriminators and structured generators to improve sample quality and diversity, especially with limited data.

papers.title: Are GANs overkill for NLP?
papers.tldr: The paper gives theoretical settings where likelihood training efficiently achieves distinguishability objectives associated with adversarial text generation.

papers.title: Can Push-forward Generative Models Fit Multimodal Distributions?
papers.tldr: Push-forward generators face a provable trade-off between Lipschitz-based stabilization and accurately representing separated modes.

papers.title: ConfounderGAN: Protecting Image Data Privacy with Causal Confounder
papers.tldr: ConfounderGAN generates visually subtle noise that creates misleading image-label correlations to obstruct unauthorized classifier training.

papers.title: DASCO: Dual-Generator Adversarial Support Constrained Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: DASCO uses two adversarial generators to pursue high-return behavior while their mixture remains close to the offline data distribution.

papers.title: DigGAN: Discriminator gradIent Gap Regularization for GAN Training with Limited Data
papers.tldr: DigGAN improves limited-data GAN training by encouraging similar discriminator gradient magnitudes for real and generated images.

papers.title: Distilling Representations from GAN Generator via Squeeze and Span
papers.tldr: Squeeze and Span transfers GAN-generator knowledge into a student using semantic invariance and real data to improve representation learning.

papers.title: FreGAN: Exploiting Frequency Components for Training GANs under Limited Data
papers.tldr: FreGAN improves image generation from limited data by emphasizing frequency information and constraining generated frequencies using real images.

papers.title: GT-GAN: General Purpose Time Series Synthesis with Generative Adversarial Networks
papers.tldr: GT-GAN combines adversarial learning with continuous-time modeling to synthesize both regular and irregular time series using one framework.

papers.title: HyperDomainNet: Universal Domain Adaptation for Generative Adversarial Networks
papers.tldr: HyperDomainNet uses a compact generator-modulation vector to support GAN adaptation across multiple domains, with possible transfer to unseen ones.

papers.title: Improving GANs with A Dynamic Discriminator
papers.tldr: DynamicD adjusts discriminator capacity during GAN training to improve synthesis under both ample-data and limited-data conditions.

papers.title: Improving Generative Adversarial Networks via Adversarial Learning in Latent Space
papers.tldr: Adversarially constructed latent transformations improve reported GAN image quality and diversity by changing the samples used for generation and training.

papers.title: Information-Theoretic GAN Compression with Variational Energy-based Model
papers.tldr: This GAN compression method trains students through a variational mutual-information objective supported by a flexible energy-based model.

papers.title: Instability and Local Minima in GAN Training with Kernel Discriminators
papers.tldr: An isolated-point model of GANs with kernel discriminators characterizes convergence conditions and explains approximate mode collapse and divergence.

papers.title: Masked Generative Adversarial Networks are Data-Efficient Generation Learners
papers.tldr: MaskedGAN improves image generation with limited data by combining spatial and spectral masking during adversarial training.

papers.title: MCL-GAN: Generative Adversarial Networks with Multiple Specialized Discriminators
papers.tldr: MCL-GAN uses specialized, backbone-sharing discriminators to mitigate mode collapse with a marginal increase in training cost.

papers.title: Mining Multi-Label Samples from Single Positive Labels
papers.tldr: S2M uses MCMC sampling to obtain multi-label GAN outputs from data annotated with only one positive label per example.

papers.title: On Translation and Reconstruction Guarantees of the Cycle-Consistent Generative Adversarial Networks
papers.tldr: The paper derives conditional finite-sample translation guarantees and reconstruction bounds for cycle-consistent adversarial networks.

papers.title: UniGAN: Reducing Mode Collapse in GANs using a Uniform Generator
papers.tldr: UniGAN targets uneven coverage of the data manifold through generator-uniformity regularization and a new diversity metric.

papers.title: UQGAN: A Unified Model for Uncertainty Quantification of Deep Classifiers trained via Conditional GANs
papers.tldr: UQGAN generates class-specific out-of-class examples to improve detection of unfamiliar inputs and false positives while increasing classification accuracy.

papers.title: Adaptive IMLE for Few-shot Pretraining-free Generative Modelling
papers.tldr: Adaptive IMLE weakens earlier theoretical restrictions and adapts to example difficulty to improve few-shot image generation.

papers.title: DeSRA: Detect and Delete the Artifacts of GAN-based Real-World Super-Resolution Models
papers.tldr: DeSRA detects super-resolution artifacts without ground-truth images and uses a few examples to fine-tune the model against similar failures.

papers.title: Directed Chain Generative Adversarial Networks
papers.tldr: Directed chain GANs incorporate an input time series into stochastic dynamics to generate multimodal series and outperform reported benchmarks.

papers.title: Existence and Estimation of Critical Batch Size for Training Generative Adversarial Networks with Two Time-Scale Update Rule
papers.tldr: For GANs trained with constant-rate two time-scale updates, a critical batch size balances fewer updates against greater work per update.

papers.title: Improving Adversarial Robustness Through the Contrastive-Guided Diffusion Process
papers.tldr: Contrastive-DP guides diffusion generation toward more distinguishable synthetic data to improve its usefulness for adversarially robust classification.

papers.title: MonoFlow: Rethinking Divergence GANs via the Perspective of Wasserstein Gradient Flows
papers.tldr: MonoFlow interprets GAN training as learned particle motion, offering a framework for understanding and designing generator losses.

papers.title: PAC-Bayesian Generalization Bounds for Adversarial Generative Models
papers.tldr: PAC-Bayesian bounds for distributional distances yield new generative-model training objectives and non-vacuous Wasserstein-GAN guarantees on synthetic data.

papers.title: Stabilizing GANs’ Training with Brownian Motion Controller
papers.tldr: A Brownian Motion Controller provides proven stability for Dirac-GANs and experimentally improves training stability in a broader GAN framework.

papers.title: StyleGAN-T: Unlocking the Power of GANs for Fast Large-Scale Text-to-Image Synthesis
papers.tldr: StyleGAN-T improves fast text-to-image generation, outperforming the compared distilled diffusion models in both sample quality and speed.

papers.title: Unveiling the Latent Space Geometry of Push-Forward Generative Models
papers.tldr: The paper links latent geometry to disconnected-distribution modeling, proves a conditional sufficient optimality result, and improves GANs with structured latent truncation.

papers.title: A Regularized Conditional GAN for Posterior Sampling in Image Recovery Problems
papers.tldr: A regularized conditional GAN rapidly generates plausible image reconstructions, with state-of-the-art posterior sampling results in MRI and inpainting.

papers.title: Augmentation-Aware Self-Supervision for Data-Efficient GAN Training
papers.tldr: Teaching a GAN discriminator to recognize augmentations improves generation in the evaluated limited-data settings.

papers.title: Balanced Training for Sparse GANs
papers.tldr: ADAPT uses a balance metric to coordinate sparse GAN training and pursue a better trade-off between performance and computational cost.

papers.title: Complexity Matters: Rethinking the Latent Space for Generative Modeling
papers.tldr: A complexity-based analysis motivates training and freezing the encoder before the final decoder, improving reported sample quality with lower model complexity.

papers.title: Dynamically Masked Discriminator for GANs
papers.tldr: A discriminator that detects adaptation slowdowns and dynamically masks features improves GAN results in the reported experiments.

papers.title: NICE: NoIse-modulated Consistency rEgularization for Data-Efficient GANs
papers.tldr: NICE combines adaptive discriminator noise with a consistency constraint to reduce GAN overfitting and stabilize training with limited data.

papers.title: Non-adversarial training of Neural SDEs with signature kernel scores
papers.tldr: Signature-kernel scoring rules enable theoretically grounded, non-adversarial neural-SDE training with improved results on sequential generation tasks.

papers.title: PCF-GAN: generating sequential data via the characteristic function of measures on the path space
papers.tldr: PCF-GAN uses path characteristic functions to compare time-series distributions and reports improved generation and reconstruction over tested baselines.

papers.title: Precision-Recall Divergence Optimization for Generative Modeling with GANs and Normalizing Flows
papers.tldr: PR-divergences turn a user-chosen balance between image quality and diversity into an explicit generative-model training objective.

papers.title: Semi-Implicit Denoising Diffusion Models (SIDDMs)
papers.tldr: SIDDMs combine implicit noisy-data modeling with explicit forward diffusion to enable large sampling steps and strong generative performance.

papers.title: Toward Understanding Generative Data Augmentation
papers.tldr: Generative augmentation can improve learning guarantees, but faster rates require sufficiently small mismatch between generated and true data distributions.

papers.title: Unifying GANs and Score-Based Diffusion as Generative Particle Models
papers.tldr: A shared particle-model framework connects GANs and score-based diffusion, motivating diffusion with a generator and adversarial generation without one.

papers.title: Improving Adversarial Energy-Based Model via Diffusion Process
papers.tldr: Embedding adversarial energy-based models into diffusion denoising steps improves generation while retaining a useful energy function for density estimation.

papers.title: MS$^3$D: A RG Flow-Based Regularization for GAN Training with Limited Data
papers.tldr: MS³D regularizes discriminator gradients for consistency across scales, improving GAN stability and image generation when training data is scarce.

papers.title: SMaRt: Improving GANs with Score Matching Regularity
papers.tldr: SMaRt supplements GAN training with score-matching regularity, using diffusion-model scores to improve generated samples in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Statistically Optimal Generative Modeling with Maximum Deviation from the Empirical Distribution
papers.tldr: Left-invertible Wasserstein GAN generators can separate from the empirical distribution without losing statistical optimality, as quantified by finite-sample bounds.

papers.title: EASI: Evolutionary Adversarial Simulator Identification for Sim-to-Real Transfer
papers.tldr: EASI uses an adversarially guided evolutionary search to fit simulator parameter distributions and improve transfer to real robots.

papers.title: Exploring the Precise Dynamics of Single-Layer GAN Models: Leveraging Multi-Feature Discriminators for High-Dimensional Subspace Learning
papers.tldr: Analysis and experiments show how interacting features help a single-layer GAN learn a more informative basis for a data subspace.

papers.title: Schrodinger Bridge Flow for Unpaired Data Translation
papers.tldr: Schrödinger Bridge Flow supports unpaired data translation without repeatedly training multiple diffusion-type models.

papers.title: The GAN is dead; long live the GAN! A Modern GAN Baseline
papers.tldr: R3GAN combines a regularized loss with local convergence guarantees and modern architecture to deliver a simpler, competitive GAN baseline.

papers.title: Direct Discriminative Optimization: Your Likelihood-Based Visual Generative Model is Secretly a GAN Discriminator
papers.tldr: DDO improves visual generation by fine-tuning likelihood-based models with an implicit discriminator and self-generated negative examples.

papers.title: Position: All Current Generative Fidelity and Diversity Metrics are Flawed
papers.tldr: Using proposed criteria and targeted sanity checks, the authors argue that current generative fidelity and diversity metrics all have important flaws.

papers.title: Bilevel Optimization for Adversarial Learning Problems: Sharpness, Generation, and Beyond
papers.tldr: A bilevel reformulation yields a provably convergent single-loop algorithm with reported improvements for GANs and Sharpness-Aware Minimization.

papers.title: Breaking Latent Prior Bias in Detectors for Generalizable AIGC Image Detection
papers.tldr: Training detectors on adversarial images generated through latent-noise optimization improves detection across unfamiliar image generators.

papers.title: Generative Model Inversion Through the Lens of the Manifold Hypothesis
papers.tldr: The paper links generative model-inversion effectiveness to gradient alignment with the generator manifold and uses that insight to improve reconstruction.

papers.title: Adversarial Flow Models
papers.tldr: Adversarial flow models directly learn one-step or few-step generation, with reported training stability and strong single-pass image-generation results.

papers.title: Scalable GANs with Transformers
papers.tldr: Latent-space transformer GANs scale reliably after targeted training fixes, reaching a reported single-step ImageNet FID of 2.18 in 60 epochs.
